description.value: The Kimberley Community Garden is a free, publicly accessible demonstration garden operated by the environmental organization Wildsight, situated at 915 Rotary Drive just south of the Aquatic Centre. Established in 2014, the site features a gazebo, an open tool shed stocked with shared equipment, composting units, and distinctive repurposed freezer beds used as planting containers. Anyone is welcome to drop in and use the space during the growing season, with no admission charge and no reserved plots.
